title: Europe
_comment: Europe for its own lessons, absolutism first (the owner asked for it on 2026-11-09). Lambert azimuthal equal-area centered on 52°N 10°E: the projection the European Union uses for its maps of Europe (ETRS89-LAEA); owner to confirm from the pictures. The box is src/focuses.json's europe focus. Its own snapshots: 1650 and 1715 (data/calendar.json).
_layout: The legend sits over the open Atlantic (top left), not over Russia; a state is named at the middle of the part the frame shows (labels_inside), so Russia's name is on European Russia, not in Siberia.
